description: This file defines the PollingRecorder class, which implements the RecorderDelegate interface for recording and managing user interactions in a web page, including polling for recorder state and handling actions.

classes.name: PollingRecorder
classes.description: A class that manages recording actions, polling for recorder state, and updating UI state in a web page.

methods.name: _pollRecorderMode
methods.description: Periodically polls the recorder state from the embedder and updates the UI if the state has changed.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Performs a specific user action via the embedder.

methods.name: recordAction
methods.description: Records a user action via the embedder.

methods.name: elementPicked
methods.description: Handles the event when an element is picked.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of the recorder.

methods.name: setOverlayState
methods.description: Sets the overlay state of the recorder.
